title: Trickster Rabbit of the Eastern Shore There you Go bumbling some more in your efforts to fool food, you forget cardinal rules about guests. #poetrypor
summary: Trickster Rabbit of the Eastern Shore There you Go bumbling some more in your efforts to fool food, you forget cardinal rules about guests. #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Trickster Rabbit
of the Eastern Shore
There you Go
bumbling some more
in your efforts to
fool food, you forget
cardinal rules
about guests.
#poetryport
